solutions.title: Recompute heights
solutions.strategy: At every node, compute left and right heights from scratch and recursively check child diameters.

timeComplexity.explanation: A skewed tree recomputes heights for many overlapping subtrees.

solutions.title: Postorder height
solutions.strategy: Compute each subtree height once and update the best path length during postorder traversal.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every node contributes one height calculation.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion stack follows tree height.
